integrity: The covering-family assertion is supported by an explicit finite certificate and a deterministic exhaustive verifier. The DP-colouring consequence uses the published theorem mu(l)=kappa(l). No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is an upper bound only: it does not determine mu(5) exactly, does not improve the published lower bound 28, and makes no optimality claim for the 64-member family.
title: A 64-member covering family for \([5]^5\) and a sharper DP-colouring threshold
